rationale.edition: Both changed paths are web/src/components/DateTime.vue and web/src/components/DateTime.spec.ts, which are OSS frontend files under web/src/ — no enterprise/ or o2_enterprise/ paths are touched and there are no enterprise-gated modules. No enterprise keywords (cipher/SSO/SAML/RBAC/SDR/sensitive-data/logo-management) appear in the changed paths or symbols, so this is an open-source change.
rationale.skip: Not skipped. The trigger comment and feature hint are empty (no explicit tests-added label or skip request), and the change is user-facing: it alters the shared DateTime picker's custom relative-period input (capping, clamping, and blur-restore behavior), which a user exercises in the UI.
rationale.e2e: E2E is warranted because the change modifies a real UI interaction: the custom relative range field now caps values at a per-unit maximum (~10 years), clamps to a whole number of at least 1, and restores the last valid value on blur when emptied. These are user-observable behaviors worth verifying through the browser.
rationale.area: The bulk of the change lives in web/src/components/, a shared components directory rather than a product-specific plugin folder (no logs/metrics/traces plugin path is touched). The DateTime picker is a general, cross-area UI component, so GeneralTests is the fitting shared-UI area.
rationale.group: GeneralTests is the OSS base shard for shared/general UI specs (sanity, schema, serviceAccount, theme-management, ingestion-config, etc.) in tests/ui-testing/ci-matrix/ci_matrix_env.json, which is the base matrix in this checkout (no ci_matrix.json exists here). A shared-component feature has no better-fitting product shard.
rationale.existing_tests: No Playwright E2E specs in the diff. The only test file changed is web/src/components/DateTime.spec.ts, which is a Vitest unit test — that is not E2E coverage under tests/ui-testing/playwright-tests/, so existing_tests_in_diff is false.
